newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB shares rebound after recent losses.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB shares rebound after recent losses.

text.p: Shares in satellite broadcaster BSkyB rose 16-1/2p to 531-1/2p on Tuesday as the stock rebounded from sharp falls over the past three weeks, traders said.
"They've come back a long way and there's actually a couple of buyers around this morning - at last. It's just given everyone an excuse to get them up," said one.

The shares have retreated from a high of 698p on October 21, a fall of nearly 24 percent on worries about Rupert Murdoch's News Corp's convertible issue and more recently negative press comment ahead of the assumption of regulation by telecoms watchdog Oftel next year.
"The overhang of the convertible issue is keeping trading volatile and there are just a couple of bottom-fishers coming in," said another trader.
